rows.intendedRepresentation: death counter transition observations from sampled source state
rows.compactSafeVersion: summary counts and validation status only unless a future schema explicitly authorizes event rows
rows.primaryRisk: event rows can be mistaken for kill, fight, or causality facts
rows.sizeRisk: low if summary-only; medium if row-based

rows.intendedRepresentation: validation summary for death counter transition extraction
rows.compactSafeVersion: single summary object with eventCount, duplicateKeyCount, sourceMethod, validationStatus, and limitations
rows.primaryRisk: low if it avoids event rows and counter values

rows.intendedRepresentation: aggregate quality and coverage over sampled match-state source observations
rows.compactSafeVersion: aggregate counts, coverage status, missingness flags, and limitations only
rows.primaryRisk: quality summaries may import position/economy aggregates that look like gameplay analysis

rows.intendedRepresentation: one-second sampled timeline rows for players and team state
rows.compactSafeVersion: not row-based in current form; only a manifest/count summary is safe now
rows.primaryRisk: timeline rows include value-bearing state and can become full match facts

rows.intendedRepresentation: configured objective-like entity class observation inventory
rows.compactSafeVersion: class-level counts and observation coverage only; no entity keys, health, team, or lifecycle claims
rows.primaryRisk: objective naming can imply destruction, completion, claim, secure, reward, or strategic semantics
rows.sizeRisk: medium if entity rows are emitted

rows.intendedRepresentation: raw observation samples for objective-like entities over time
rows.compactSafeVersion: no lifecycle rows in current policy; only aggregate availability metadata is safe now
rows.primaryRisk: lifecycle wording and health samples can be overread as destruction or objective completion

rows.intendedRepresentation: controller, pawn, and player identity reconciliation sampled once per second
rows.compactSafeVersion: only aggregate reconciliation coverage and mismatch counts are safe now
rows.primaryRisk: current form can include player arrays and sampled snapshots

rows.compactSafeVersion: summary counts and validation status only unless event-row schema is separately approved
rows.primaryRisk: respawn label can be overread as death causality or mechanics timing
rows.sizeRisk: low if summary-only; medium if row-based

reviewConclusion: Only death_validation is safe enough to design next because it can remain summary-only. Row-bearing timelines, snapshots, objective lifecycle, and field-value surfaces remain blocked.
